result.finding: Event-Driven Single-Service Application. The application follows a minimal event-driven architecture: it is a standalone Spring Boot service that produces messages to Azure Service Bus queues (queue1 and queue2). There is no layering (no Controller/Service/Repository split), no API gateway, and no service discovery — it is a single deployable unit that acts purely as a message producer.
evidence: Only 2 source classes: MessagingRabbitmqApplication and Producer
Producer sends messages via ServiceBusTemplate to Azure Service Bus — event-driven outbound messaging
No service discovery (Eureka, Consul) or API gateway (Zuul, Spring Gateway) found
Single Maven module — single deployable JAR
